about.title: Most software skips most of the world. We don't.
about.everyone: Most software is built for people with fast internet, new phones and a credit card. Emigisha builds for everyone else too. Our products support the things big tools tend to skip: mobile money, low connectivity, local languages.
about.name: The name comes from Mashi, the language of the Bashi people of eastern Congo. It means blessings, and it is the bar we hold our work to.
